events.text: Doctrine: Take east crossing (F3) and hold it. I have units near F3 (rhino-inf-1, rhino-inf-2, rhino-arch-1). I must secure F3 immediately. Kite and Tiger are strong at F3/SE area. I will reinforce F3 and threaten the other crossings.

events.text: My doctrine mandates taking the east ford (F3) early. Rhino is at F3 area (NBE). Tiger is at F3 area (SBE). I must secure F3. Kite inf-1/arch-1 are at F3. I will reinforce F3 and pressure the enemies there while moving towards F2 to secure two fords.

events.text: Doctrine mandates holding F1 (West Ford) and taking the west crossing early. All units are at F1 (2w old). I will reinforce F1 and prepare for the next phase, maintaining defensive posture as per doctrine.
